quote: If you are a real estate agent who has no value outside of your ability to operate a lock box, my prediction is that in the next 18 to 24 months, you will be reclassified as a gig worker in this space.
why_clipworthy: Challenges agents to rethink their value proposition in the industry.
suggested_hook: Are you just a lockbox operator? Here's why you might become a gig worker soon.
